Earth orbit will test one or both commercial landers from SpaceX and Blue Origin respectively. The mission will launch crew in the Orion spacecraft on top of the SLS (Space Launch System) rocket to test rendezvous and docking capabilities between Orion and private commercial spacecraft needed to land astronauts on the Moon. This test will take place with one or both providers. Was this page helpful? Δ Was this page helpful? Yes No × Notifications
